question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution talks about the duties and powers of the Comptroller and Auditor General of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 149.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 149 **of the Indian Constitution talks about the **duties and powers** of the **Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)**.
 
• The CAG is responsible for **auditing the accounts **of the **Union and State governments, local bodies, and other public authorities**.
 
• The CAG is also empowered to conduct** performance audits **of government programs and schemes to ensure their effectiveness and efficiency.
 
• The CAG reports its findings to the **President or Governor,** who then places them before the** Parliament or State Legislature, **respectively.
 
• The CAG is an independent constitutional authority appointed by the **President of India **and holds office for a term of six years or until the **age of 65**, whichever is earlier.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** As per the Article 160** of the Indian Constitution Discharge of the functions of the Governor in certain contingencies The President may make such provision as he thinks fit for the discharge of the functions of the Governor of a State in any contingency not provided for in this Chapter.
 
• **Article 148** deals with the appointment of the **Comptroller and Auditor General of India.**
